rationale: Raw source table 14 is the June 30, 2024 Schedule of Investments in thousands. In the United Kingdom / Debt Investments / Commercial and Professional Services section, the Ineos Quattro row shows principal 443, cost 434, and fair value 443 (thousand). The extracted holding instead carries cost 34000 and fair_value 443000, creating the X07 ratio. The source therefore grounds a localized extraction error in the cost field.
